description_en: Queries the details of a specified data source
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定数据源的详细信息
name: GetParserDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If your instance has an ID, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The data source ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html operation to query the list of data sources and obtain the DataSourceId
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID。您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html，查询数据源列表，获取**DataSourceId**
parameters.name: data_source_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

DataSource.description_en: The details of the data source
DataSource.description_zh: 返回的数据源详细信息

CreateUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the data source

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

UtcCreated.description_en: The time when the data source was created in UTC. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'` format

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
